Legal notice gives no explicit rule on automated access or rate limits. robots.txt (https://ted.europa.eu/robots.txt) disallows /*/search/result? (dynamic website search URLs) and blocks Sogou/PetalBot; so use the API, not the website search pages.
sources.notes: Best EU-wide procurement source. Full-text hits include noise (e.g. 'core banking' in unrelated lots); validate with CPV filters. Rate limits and max page size not stated in the pages I opened; check the Swagger at api.ted.europa.eu/swagger. Only above-EU-threshold notices are on TED; national below-threshold tenders need national portals (see BOAMP).

sources.source: BOAMP (Bulletin officiel des annonces des marchés publics) open data, DILA, France
sources.count_method: GET https://boamp-datadila.opendatasoft.com/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/boamp/records?where=search("progiciel")&limit=0 . Response field `total_count` (verified live: search("progiciel") returned total_count=4726). Opendatasoft ODSQL `where` clause supports search() full text plus field filters; full exports via /exports/ endpoints.
sources.robots_or_terms: Dataset licence etalab-2.0 (Licence Ouverte), shown on dataset page. robots.txt (https://boamp-datadila.opendatasoft.com/robots.txt) has `User-agent: * Disallow: /api/` and disallows /explore/dataset/*/download; only Googlebot is allowed /api/. So the licence permits reuse, but generic crawlers are told not to hit /api/. Treat the API as the intended programmatic channel for a declared, low-rate research client, or confirm with DILA; this is a real tension, not resolved by the pages I read.
sources.notes: Covers French national tenders including below-EU-threshold ones that TED lacks. French keywords needed (progiciel, logiciel de gestion, système d'information hospitalier, mainframe, COBOL).

sources.source: Bundesagentur für Arbeit Jobsuche API (Germany's federal employment agency job board)
sources.count_method: GET https://rest.arbeitsagentur.de/jobboerse/jobsuche-service/pc/v6/jobs?was=COBOL&size=1 with header X-API-Key: jobboerse-jobsuche (public clientId given in the OpenAPI spec). Response field `maxErgebnisse` is the total (verified live: was=COBOL returned maxErgebnisse=49). The `facetten.arbeitgeber.counts` object in the same response gives per-employer counts (e.g. Finanz Informatik, TARGOBANK, SIGNAL IDUNA, Deutsche Rentenversicherung for COBOL), which directly answers 'which organisations'.
sources.robots_or_terms: The OpenAPI spec (community bundesAPI project, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bundesAPI/jobsuche-api/main/openapi.yaml) publishes the shared clientId for X-API-Key; it is documentation of the agency's own app backend, not an official open-data licence. https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/robots.txt is `User-agent: * Allow: /`. rest.arbeitsagentur.de/robots.txt returned no content. I found no formal terms of use for the REST API itself.
sources.notes: `was` is free-text on job title/content; `veroeffentlichtseit` limits to last 0-100 days, so counts are a snapshot of live postings. Employer facet is the strongest organisation-level signal found in this survey.

sources.source: France Travail API Offres d'emploi v2 (French public employment service)
sources.count_method: GET .../offresdemploi/v2/offres/search?motsCles=COBOL&range=0-0 with an OAuth2 client-credentials token. The total is in the Content-Range response header, format `offres 0-0/<total>`; take the number after the slash. Pagination is capped (range start max 1000, end max 1149, max 150 per request), but the header total is the true total regardless of the cap.
sources.robots_or_terms: Free but requires creating an account and an application on francetravail.io to get client_id/client_secret (per the wrapper README https://github.com/etiennekintzler/api-offres-emploi). data.gouv.fr lists it among France Travail's open APIs (https://www.data.gouv.fr/organizations/france-travail/dataservices); licence not stated there. francetravail.io/robots.txt disallows /api-peio/ and /oauth2/ for crawlers; I did not fetch robots.txt for the API host itself. Rate limits not found in pages I opened.
sources.notes: The francetravail.io page did not render content for me; count mechanics are confirmed by the third-party wrapper README, not the official doc. Not verified live because it needs credentials. Agency/ESN postings mask the end client, so expect intermediary noise.

sources.source: EURES job search (European Commission job mobility portal)
sources.count_method: POST https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv-search/search with body including {"resultsPerPage":1,"page":1,"keywords":[{"keyword":"COBOL","specificSearchCode":"EVERYWHERE"}], ...empty filter arrays}. Response field `numberRecords` is the total (verified live: 2314 for COBOL). Response `facets` gives counts by POSITION_LOCATION (country/NUTS), NACE_CODE (sector, e.g. K = finance, O = public administration, Q = health) and language.
sources.robots_or_terms: Endpoint is undocumented by the Commission; the GitHub spec says it is unofficial and not endorsed by the Commission or EURES, and use is governed by EURES portal terms. https://eures.europa.eu/robots.txt disallows search, admin and user pages for crawlers. No official open-data licence for vacancy data found.
sources.notes: Keyword matching looks broad: COBOL returned 2314 hits with 1255 in NACE N (admin/support services, likely staffing agencies) and 1723 in Germany (EURES ingests the BA feed, so it double-counts with the BA source). Use for cross-country comparison, not absolute counts. No employer facet was in the response.

sources.source: EBA Credit Institutions Register (EUCLID)
sources.count_method: No documented public API. The register is an Angular app behind a disclaimer (https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/register/cir/disclaimer); its JS calls internal paths /register/cir-api and /register/pir-api, and only the Payment Institutions Register exposes a 'Download Register' route (/pir/registerDownload). For banks, count by running a search by country/entity type in the UI. No keyword-to-count mechanism applies; this is a denominator source (number of banks per country).
sources.robots_or_terms: https://euclid.eba.europa.eu/robots.txt returns 404 (no robots file). Terms sit on the disclaimer page, which did not render for me, so I could not read them. EBA's page https://www.eba.europa.eu/risk-and-data-analysis/data/registers-and-other-list-institutions/other-list-institutions points to EUCLID and to other lists as .xlsx files.
sources.notes: Use as the denominator of credit institutions to normalise job/tender counts. Evidence on download format for CIR is weak; I found third-party claims of a JSON download but did not confirm one for CIR.

sources.source: EIOPA Register of Insurance Undertakings
sources.count_method: Search page shows 'N result(s)' (24929 with no filters when I opened it); filter by home country, cross-border status, LEI, registration dates; export the result set as CSV or Excel and count rows. No API mentioned.
sources.robots_or_terms: Page disclaimer: EIOPA accepts no liability for completeness or accuracy; national competent authority registers prevail; updated weekly on Fridays. No reuse licence stated. robots.txt request redirects to a SharePoint not-found page (no robots file).
sources.notes: Denominator for insurers. 24929 includes cross-border passporting entries, so de-duplicate by LEI to count undertakings.

sources.source: ECB Banking Supervision list of supervised entities
sources.count_method: PDF list; header states the count of significant entities (114 as at cut-off 1 January 2025). Less significant institutions are listed by country in the same PDF; extract with pdftotext and count rows. No API or keyword search.
sources.robots_or_terms: No terms or robots evidence collected for bankingsupervision.europa.eu in this pass; say unknown. The HTML index page I tried returned 404.
sources.notes: Gives LEI per bank, so it joins to GLEIF and EBA. Good for a 'large banks' stratum. PDF only, so parsing is required.

sources.source: GLEIF LEI API (global Legal Entity Identifier records)
sources.count_method: GET https://api.gleif.org/api/v1/lei-records?filter[fulltext]=bank&page[size]=1 . Field `meta.pagination.total` is the total (verified live: 40677 for fulltext 'bank'). Add filter[entity.legalAddress.country]=DE etc. for country splits. Also offers free daily golden-copy bulk files.
sources.robots_or_terms: Terms (https://www.gleif.org/en/meta/lei-data-terms-of-use): LEI data under CC0 1.0; no claiming endorsement by GLEIF; access only through the provided Access Service, no circumventing technical restrictions. https://api.gleif.org/robots.txt is `User-agent: * Disallow:` (everything allowed).
sources.notes: Not a legacy-software signal by itself; it is the join key that links banks/insurers in EBA, EIOPA, ECB and ESEF sources to employer names in job and tender data.

sources.source: FINESS (French national register of health and social care establishments), data.gouv.fr
sources.count_method: Download the CSV and count rows filtered by the establishment category column (hospital categories). The data.gouv.fr dataset API (https://www.data.gouv.fr/api/1/datasets/?q=finess) returns a `total` field, but that counts datasets, not establishments. Category codes for hospitals were not verified in this pass.
sources.robots_or_terms: Licence Ouverte / Open Licence (dataset page). This extraction is deprecated: last updated 12 May 2026, replaced by 'FINESS Structures' and 'FINESS Activities' generated daily by the Agence du Numérique en Santé. Use the replacement datasets.
sources.notes: Hospital denominator for France; pair with BOAMP tenders mentioning 'système d'information hospitalier' or named HIS vendors. I found no EU-wide official hospital register; the German Destatis hospital directory URL I tried returned 404.

sources.source: filings.xbrl.org (XBRL International index of ESEF annual financial reports)
sources.count_method: GET https://filings.xbrl.org/api/filings?page[size]=1 (JSON:API). Field `meta.count` is the total (verified live: 25954 filings). Filter by country, LEI or period. There is no full-text keyword search over report text, so keyword counts (e.g. 'core banking system', 'mainframe') require downloading the xBRL-JSON or report packages and searching locally.
sources.robots_or_terms: About page: 'At present, there are no restrictions on the ways that the data can be used.' robots.txt returns 404 (none). Coverage gaps: Germany and Ireland filings are not publicly discoverable there.
sources.notes: Regulator-mandated filings of listed issuers. Useful for finding IT modernisation or legacy-system risk disclosures in listed banks and insurers, but only via local text mining of downloaded reports. Not a primary regulator site itself; it aggregates national OAM filings.

sources.source: Contracts Finder (Crown Commercial Service) - search_notices API v2
sources.count_method: POST https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/api/rest/2/search_notices/json with body {"searchCriteria":{"keyword":"mainframe"},"size":1}. The JSON top-level field "hitCount" is the total. Tested live 2026-10-05: keyword 'mainframe' returned hitCount 71 with no auth (the first hit was a DVLA mainframe service notice). The docs describe OAuth2 client credentials (Sid4Gov login), but that seems needed only for publishing. Anonymous search worked.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt returns 404, so there are no crawl rules. Terms (https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Home/TermsAndConditions): content is under OGL v3.0 and the site offers feeds for reuse. It bans crawling that impairs or disrupts the system and bans avoiding access or storage limits. No published rate limit.
sources.notes: Covers below-threshold UK public contracts (central government above about £12k, wider public sector above about £30k). An archive for 2011 to 2015 is on data.gov.uk. Good for counting buyers by keyword (COBOL, AS400, iSeries, SAP, Oracle EBS, core banking, PAS/EPR). Dedupe notices per buyer before counting organisations.

sources.source: Find a Tender Service (FTS) - OCDS API and data.gov.uk bulk
sources.count_method: No keyword-count API was found. The OCDS endpoint https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages?limit=N&updatedFrom=...&updatedTo=... pages by date only (tested live, returns OCDS 1.1 JSON). To count by keyword, pull every release (or the daily XML ZIPs on data.gov.uk) and filter title, description and CPV locally. The web UI at /Search/Results shows "We've found N notices" (315,465 unfiltered), but a GET ?keywords=mainframe was ignored in testing because the form is POST with session state. So a UI keyword count is not reliably scriptable.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt returns 404. Terms (https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/Home/TermsAndConditions): OGL v3.0. Feeds are offered for other sites to reuse. Crawling that impairs or disrupts the system is banned, as is avoiding access or storage restrictions. Access requests are logged. No rate limit is documented.
sources.notes: Above-threshold UK notices since 2021, including Procurement Act 2023 notices. Use CPV codes 48xxxxxx (software packages) and 72xxxxxx (IT services) plus keywords. Pair it with Contracts Finder for coverage below the threshold.

sources.source: Digital Marketplace G-Cloud service search (CCS)
sources.count_method: GET https://www.applytosupply.digitalmarketplace.service.gov.uk/g-cloud/search?q=mainframe and parse the text "N results found containing <q>". Tested live: 'mainframe' gave 73 results found across all lots. This counts supplier SERVICES, not buyer organisations.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt returns a 404 page, so there are no rules. Terms (https://www.applytosupply.digitalmarketplace.service.gov.uk/terms-and-conditions): content is under OGL v3.0, with no clause on automated access or scraping.
sources.notes: Measures the supply side: how many vendors sell mainframe, COBOL or AS400 support. It does not show which public bodies run legacy systems. No public API was confirmed.

sources.source: Adzuna Jobs API (GB)
sources.count_method: GET http://api.adzuna.com/v1/api/jobs/gb/search/1?app_id=..&app_key=..&what=cobol (also what_phrase and what_exclude). The docs page I opened does not name the total-count field, so I could not confirm the field name (no key was available to test). Check the response before relying on it.
sources.robots_or_terms: Terms (https://developer.adzuna.com/docs/terms_of_service): free tier is limited to 25 calls a minute, 250 a day, 1,000 a week and 2,500 a month. Commercial, government and academic users get 14 days for testing only. Aggregating the data (vacancy counts, average salaries) or ongoing use needs written consent. Research use must credit Adzuna. www.adzuna.co.uk/robots.txt returned a CloudFront 403 to my request.
sources.notes: MAJOR CAVEAT: the terms forbid published vacancy counts without written consent. Ask Adzuna for permission before using it for counts. Employer names are in the results, so counts per organisation would be possible.

sources.source: Reed.co.uk Jobseeker API
sources.count_method: GET https://www.reed.co.uk/api/1.0/search?keywords=cobol with HTTP Basic auth (API key as username, empty password). Returns at most 100 per page (resultsToTake, resultsToSkip). I could NOT verify the total-count field name: the docs page sits behind a Cloudflare challenge, and an unauthenticated call returned 401.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt and the developer pages (https://www.reed.co.uk/developers/jobseeker) returned a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge, so the terms could not be read. A secondary source (jobspipe.dev) says no rate limit is documented. Read Reed's terms manually before use.
sources.notes: The source field is a secondary blog because the primary docs were blocked. Search is by keyword only, with no industry filter. postedByDirectEmployer=true cuts down agency duplicates. Employer names come back in the results.

sources.source: Companies House Public Data API (company search and advanced search)
sources.count_method: GET https://api.company-information.service.gov.uk/search/companies?q=... gives the total in the 'total_results' field (per the companysearch resource spec). Advanced search /advanced-search/companies takes sic_codes, company_status, company_type and incorporated_from/to, with size up to 5000. The docs I read did not state its total field, so check the response. A free API key is required (unauthenticated calls return 401).
sources.robots_or_terms: Developer guidelines (https://developer.company-information.service.gov.uk/developer-guidelines): 600 requests per 5 minutes, then 429. Apps that regularly exceed or bypass the limits can be banned without notice. download.companieshouse.gov.uk/robots.txt is 'Disallow:' (everything allowed).
sources.notes: Use it as the denominator and sector frame, via SIC 64191 (banks), 65110/65120 (insurance) and 86101 (hospitals). It holds no software data. The monthly Free Company Data Product CSV (https://download.companieshouse.gov.uk/en_output.html, about 471MB, includes SIC codes) gives bulk counts by SIC with no API calls. That page states no formal licence.

sources.source: Companies House Accounts Data Product (iXBRL bulk)
sources.count_method: Download the daily ZIPs (last 60 days) or the monthly archives (last 12 months). Full-text search the iXBRL HTML for keywords (e.g. 'mainframe', 'legacy system', 'core banking', 'SAP') and count distinct company numbers. There is no hosted search or count endpoint.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt on download.companieshouse.gov.uk has an empty Disallow (everything allowed). The page says the data is free of charge and not supported. It states no explicit licence.
sources.notes: Covers about 75% of roughly 2.2M annual accounts (electronic filers only). Files are 51 to 597 MiB each. Most are small-company accounts with no narrative. Strategic reports from large companies sometimes mention IT modernisation. Expect low recall.

sources.source: FCA Financial Services Register API
sources.count_method: GET https://register.fca.org.uk/services/V0.1/Search?q=<name>&type=firm with headers X-Auth-Email and X-Auth-Key (free signup). The response 'ResultInfo' carries 'total_count' (per the open-source client docs). Search is by name only, with no keyword over permissions. An unauthenticated call returned 403.
sources.robots_or_terms: register.fca.org.uk/robots.txt: 'User-agent: * Allow: /' (only forgot-password is disallowed). Search snippets say the API is BETA, built for lookups of one entity at a time, and limited to 50 requests per 10 seconds. I could not open the FCA's own page to confirm this (fca.org.uk returned 403). A Register Extract Service exists for bulk data, but its handbook PDF returned 403, so its cost is unknown.
sources.notes: Use it as a firm-universe denominator for regulated financial firms, not for software signals. The source is a third-party client's docs because fca.org.uk pages blocked fetches.

sources.source: Bank of England / PRA lists of regulated banks, building societies, credit unions, insurers
sources.count_method: Download the monthly CSVs (Banks, Building Societies, Credit Unions, Insurers, latest September 2026) and count rows. The 2025 banks CSV link was tested: HTTP 200, text/csv. There is no keyword search. It is a clean denominator list (with LEIs since June 2025) to join against procurement and job counts.
sources.robots_or_terms: bankofengland.co.uk/robots.txt disallows /search, /forms, /boeapps/iadb and similar, but not /-/media/ or the prudential-regulation pages, so CSV download is allowed. I did not review a specific reuse licence.
sources.notes: About 1,300 PRA-regulated firms. This is the best primary list of UK banks and insurers for a study of core banking and insurance policy admin systems. Ring-fenced bodies are published as an annual PDF.

sources.source: NHS England Organisation Data Service - ORD API
sources.count_method: GET https://directory.spineservices.nhs.uk/ORD/2-0-0/organisations?PrimaryRoleId=RO197&Status=Active&Limit=1. The HTTP response header 'x-total-count' is the total. Tested live: 247 active NHS trusts (RO197). Use other role codes for other organisation types. No auth needed.
sources.robots_or_terms: directory.spineservices.nhs.uk/robots.txt returns '404 page not found', so there are no rules. The api.gov.uk catalogue entry for the ODS APIs says content is under OGL v3.0. The digital.nhs.uk docs pages returned 403 to my fetch, so I could not read rate limits.
sources.notes: The denominator for the hospital and EPR study (trusts and sites). It holds no software data. Join ODS codes to NHS buyers in Contracts Finder and FTS to count trusts procuring PAS/EPR replacements.

sources.source: Government Procurement via GeBIZ (MOF dataset on data.gov.sg, awarded tenders FY2021+)
sources.count_method: GET https://data.gov.sg/api/action/datastore_search?resource_id=d_acde1106003906a75c3fa052592f2fcb&q=<keyword>&limit=1 and read result.total (q='core banking' returned total=31 on 2026-10-05). q is full-text and appears to match either word (first hit was a 'soil and core samples' tender), so filter tender_description client-side or download the CSV for exact-phrase counts. Fields: tender_no, tender_description, agency, award_date, tender_detail_status, supplier_name, awarded_amt.
sources.robots_or_terms: data.gov.sg robots.txt: 'User-agent: * Allow: /'. Singapore Open Data Licence v1.0 allows commercial and non-commercial use, copying, adapting, with attribution notice and link to licence. Rate limits (per 10 s): datastore_search 4 calls without key, 8 with dev key, 20 with prod key; dataset downloads 2/4/10; exceeding returns 429.
sources.notes: Awards only (tender description, agency, supplier, amount), not open calls. ~18.5K rows, CSV 4.2 MB, coverage Apr 2021 to Mar 2026, last updated Apr 2026 per search snippet. Best free bulk source for counting legacy-system maintenance/replacement contracts by agency.

sources.source: GeBIZ business opportunities listing (live tenders/quotations)
sources.count_method: Web UI keyword search on BOListing page ('Match All'/'Match Any' options); page shows a header like '6509 opportunities found' which updates to the filtered total. No API, RSS or export found on the page.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt: 'User-agent: * Allow: / Disallow: /scripts/'. GeBIZ Terms and Conditions clause 19.1: GeBIZ or any part 'shall not be reproduced... stored in an information retrieval system or mirrored' without the Government's prior written permission. Read counts manually; do not bulk-mirror. Terms PDF: https://www.gebiz.gov.sg/docs/GeBIZ_Terms_and_Conditions.pdf
sources.notes: Listing is viewable without login (Singpass login options shown for bidding). Covers open and recent opportunities rather than history; use the data.gov.sg awards dataset for historical counts.

sources.source: MyCareersFuture (WSG national job portal) public JSON search API
sources.count_method: GET https://api.mycareersfuture.gov.sg/v2/jobs?search=<keyword>&limit=1&page=0 and read top-level field 'total'. On 2026-10-05: search=COBOL total=23 (first hit an AS400 COBOL contract role); search=mainframe total=18. Results carry company name, so per-employer counts need paging through all results.
sources.robots_or_terms: www.mycareersfuture.gov.sg robots.txt: 'User-agent: * Disallow:' (empty, all allowed). Terms (seen only via search snippet, employer terms page did not render): Website Content shall not be reproduced, republished or distributed without WSG prior written permission. API is undocumented/unofficial; counts and aggregates are lower risk than republishing listings.
sources.notes: Largest free SG job source with an open endpoint. Keyword search is full-text; recruiters/agencies often post on behalf of the real employer, so employer attribution needs cleaning. Terms page fetch failed, so terms evidence is second-hand.

sources.source: Careers@Gov (public service job portal)
sources.count_method: No evidence gathered: jobs.careers.gov.sg page content did not render via fetch, so I could not confirm whether a total count is displayed. robots.txt disallows /api/, so any JSON endpoint should not be used.
sources.robots_or_terms: jobs.careers.gov.sg robots.txt: 'Allow: / Disallow: /api/'. www.careers.gov.sg robots.txt: 'Allow: / Disallow: /search'. Terms of Use linked at /terms-of-use/ but not read.
sources.notes: Relevant for government-agency demand for legacy skills (16 ministries, 50+ statutory boards). Many public-sector roles also appear on MyCareersFuture, which is easier to count. Treat as manual-check only.

sources.source: ACRA Information on Corporate Entities (data.gov.sg, split by first letter of name)
sources.count_method: Per-letter datasets (e.g. 'D' = d_acbc938ec77af18f94cecc4a7c9ec720). GET https://data.gov.sg/api/action/datastore_search?resource_id=<id>&q=<keyword>&limit=1 and read result.total (q=SOFTWARE on 'D' returned 598). For a national count sum across all letter datasets, or download CSVs and filter on primary_ssic_code / primary_user_described_activity.
sources.robots_or_terms: data.gov.sg robots.txt allows all. Singapore Open Data Licence: free personal and commercial use with attribution. Same datastore_search rate limits (4 calls/10 s without key).
sources.notes: 53 columns incl. UEN, entity status, SSIC codes, user-described activity, officer count, audit firm. Updated monthly on the 16th. Gives the denominator (all companies by sector) and UENs to join with procurement suppliers and MAS licensees. Does not say what software a company runs.

sources.source: MAS Financial Institutions Directory (banks, insurers, other licensees)
sources.count_method: Filter by sector or licence via URL, e.g. ?sector=Banking shows '195 results' with facets (Local Banks 6, Full Banks 20, Wholesale Banks 95, Merchant Banks 21, Finance Companies 3, Rep Offices 27); ?sector=Insurance shows '388 results' (Direct Insurer Life 16, General 52, Composite 9, Captive General 78, Registered Brokers 111, etc.). Counts are licences, not institutions (one FI can hold several). 'Print/Download List' option on results page. term= search matches institution names, not technology.
sources.robots_or_terms: eservices.mas.gov.sg/robots.txt returned a maintenance page, not a robots file. www.mas.gov.sg robots.txt: 'User-Agent: * Crawl-delay: 2'. MAS Terms of Use: no content may be reproduced or distributed without MAS written permission; one personal non-commercial copy allowed; must not place 'disproportionately large load' on MAS systems.
sources.notes: Authoritative denominator for banks and insurers that could run core-banking or policy-admin systems. Also opened https://eservices.mas.gov.sg/fid/institution?sector=Insurance.

sources.source: MOH Health Facilities statistics (hospital counts by type and sector)
sources.count_method: Read the table or download the 'Health Facilities [XLSX, 36 KB]' file. As of 26 May 2025: acute hospitals 20 (public 11, not-for-profit 1, private 8); community hospitals 10 (public 6, NFP 4); psychiatric 1. Counts only, no keyword search.
sources.robots_or_terms: moh.gov.sg robots.txt: 'Allow: / Disallow: /search'. MOH website terms not read.
sources.notes: Gives the hospital denominator. The page does not list hospital names. The HCI Directory (hcidirectory.gov.sg) for named licensed institutions could not be reached (DNS failure), so no evidence for it.

sources.source: Health Facilities and Beds in Inpatient Facilities (MOH collection on data.gov.sg)
sources.count_method: Download CSVs or query via the data.gov.sg collection/dataset APIs. Annual counts of acute, psychiatric and community hospitals, nursing homes, hospices, plus a public/NFP/private split. Coverage Jan 2009 to Dec 2022 per the page.
sources.robots_or_terms: data.gov.sg robots.txt allows all; Singapore Open Data Licence with attribution; rate limits as above.
sources.notes: Time series of facility counts. Older than the MOH page (ends 2022). No keyword search over technology.

sources.source: SGX Company Announcements (listed-company disclosures)
sources.count_method: No free documented API confirmed. The backend https://api.sgx.com/announcements/v1.1/?...&value=<keyword> returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized when called directly (it expects a token issued to the SGX web page). The public page did not render via fetch, so I could not confirm whether the UI shows a total count. Only paid third-party scrapers (Apify) appeared in search results.
sources.robots_or_terms: sgx.com robots.txt: 'User-agent: * Allow: /'. SGX terms page (https://www.sgx.com/terms-use) did not render readable text, so terms on automated access or redistribution are unverified.
sources.notes: Most useful filings source for listed banks, insurers and corporates disclosing core-system replacements, IT outages or MAS directions. Treat as manual search until a sanctioned access route is confirmed.

sources.source: Central Public Procurement Portal (GeM-CPPP, NIC) – Latest Active Tenders / Tender Search
sources.count_method: Unfiltered: the Latest Active Tenders page prints a total in the HTML, 'Total Tenders : 31043' when fetched on 2026-10-05. Keyword: the form field s_keyword (min 3 chars) matches Tender ID, Title, Ref No and Description. Every submit requires an image CAPTCHA (captcha_sid/captcha_response). The Result of Tenders page shows no total count. Keyword counts can only be collected by hand, one query at a time. Automating them would mean bypassing a CAPTCHA, so it is not an option.
sources.robots_or_terms: https://eprocure.gov.in/cppp/robots.txt (opened) is a stock Drupal file: User-agent * disallows /search/, /admin/, /user/* and core paths, and does not disallow the tender listing paths. I did not find a terms-of-use page (/cppp/termsandconditions returned 404). The CAPTCHA on the search forms is the effective restriction.
sources.notes: No public API or bulk download found. The CPPP FAQ PDF (https://eprocure.gov.in/cppp/sites/default/files/eproc/CPPP-FAQs.pdf, opened) mentions Tender Search, Search by Organisation and Result of Tenders, but no API or RSS. The NIC eProcurement advanced search (https://eprocure.gov.in/eprocure/app?page=FrontEndAdvancedSearch&service=page, opened) also has a captcha field. Good fit for counting tenders that mention 'core banking', 'Finacle', 'AS400', 'COBOL', 'HMIS' or 'ERP', but only by hand.

sources.source: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) BidPlus – All Bids
sources.count_method: Not verified. Every connection to bidplus.gem.gov.in and gem.gov.in was refused from this network (ECONNREFUSED), with both WebFetch and curl. A third-party repo (https://github.com/NamanGupta8/gem_bid_monitor, opened) describes an undocumented POST endpoint, bidplus.gem.gov.in/search-bids, that needs a CSRF cookie and token and returns about 10 bids per page. That README does not document a total-count field.
sources.robots_or_terms: No evidence. robots.txt and the terms page were unreachable (connection refused).
sources.notes: This is probably the largest Indian procurement source by bid volume, but nothing here is verified. Re-test from an Indian IP or a different network before relying on it. The search endpoint is internal and undocumented, not an official API.

sources.source: Naukri.com job search
sources.count_method: The SERP (e.g. /cobol-jobs) is a client-rendered Next.js shell. The fetched HTML contains no count. The underlying /jobapi/v3/search?keyword=cobol... returned HTTP 400: 'Please provide the valid App Id and SystemId in Header'. A total job count shows only in a real browser session. There is no public API.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened, edited May 13 2026) sets Disallow: / for Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended and others. User-agent * disallows only /advertiser/, /preview/ etc. The terms page (https://www.naukri.com/termsconditions, opened but rendered client-side, so no text) reportedly bars 'automated means to crawl and/or scrape' (from search snippet, not verified on page).
sources.notes: India's largest job board and the most useful for COBOL, AS400, mainframe, Finacle, Flexcube and SAP skill demand. Automated counting is blocked by robots.txt for AI agents and, reportedly, by the terms. A human can read the counts by hand.

sources.source: Indeed India (in.indeed.com) job search
sources.count_method: A fetch of /jobs?q=cobol returned HTTP 403 (bot wall), so I could not see the count on the page. In a browser, the SERP header shows an 'N jobs' total. There is no public search API.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened): User-agent * has Allow: / but disallows /jobs/<country>/ paths and /api/getrecjobs. A separate group listing AI and training bots (Meta-ExternalAgent, ClaudeBot, DeepSeekBot, GrokBot, Diffbot, etc.) disallows /jobs, /m/jobs, /Jobs and /q-. I did not open the terms.
sources.notes: Secondary job source. Automated use is effectively blocked: 403 on fetch, and robots disallows /jobs for the AI-bot group.

sources.source: RBI – List of Scheduled Commercial Banks
sources.count_method: Read the HTML table, or download the 140 kb PDF. On fetch it had 121 banks: 12 SBI and nationalised, 21 private, 11 small finance, 5 payments, 28 regional rural, 44 foreign. This is a denominator, not a keyword search.
sources.robots_or_terms: https://www.rbi.org.in/robots.txt returned HTTP 418 'Unauthorised Access' to curl, so I could not read it. No terms page was checked. The page itself loaded through WebFetch.
sources.notes: The authoritative population of banks for a core-banking study. Co-operative banks are not in this list. Use the RBI IFSC files, or UCB lists, for those.

sources.source: RBI – NEFT-enabled bank branches (bank-wise IFSC/MICR Excel files)
sources.count_method: Bulk download: one .xlsx per bank (about 320+ institutions, updated 15 Sep 2026). Count the rows per file for branch counts, and count the files for institutions. No keyword search.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt unreadable (HTTP 418 to curl). No terms checked. Public download links.
sources.notes: Broadest free list of banking entities, including co-operative and small banks, which are the likeliest to run legacy core-banking systems. Branch counts give a size weighting.

sources.source: IRDAI – Lists of Life, General and Health Insurers
sources.count_method: Count the HTML table rows. On fetch: 26 life insurers (list-of-life-insurers1), 28 general insurers (list-of-general-insurers), 8 standalone health insurers (list-of-health-insurers). Reinsurers are on a separate page. No keyword search or download.
sources.robots_or_terms: https://www.irdai.gov.in/robots.txt (opened): User-Agent * Disallow: /, plus explicit Disallow: / for Googlebot, bingbot, ChatGPT-User and others. Automated crawling is disallowed. Use manual reading only.
sources.notes: The complete insurer population is about 60 entities, small enough to copy by hand. Also opened: https://irdai.gov.in/list-of-life-insurers1 and https://irdai.gov.in/list-of-general-insurers.

sources.source: Open Government Data Platform India (data.gov.in) – OGD API (e.g. MCA Company Master Data, NCS datasets)
sources.count_method: API: GET https://api.data.gov.in/resource/{resource_id}?api-key=...&format=json&filters[field]=value&limit&offset. The JSON response carries 'total' (all matching records) and 'count' (this page), according to a third-party guide. Filters are exact-match on fields, not free-text keyword search. Not verified live: api.data.gov.in and catalog pages returned 503 or 403 throughout. Only the homepage loaded (HTTP 200) once.
sources.robots_or_terms: No evidence. robots.txt and the terms page returned 503 (Akamai) during this session. Datasets are published under the Government Open Data License – India per general knowledge, but I did not verify that on the page.
sources.notes: Search snippets (not verified) say the MCA Company Master Data (RoC-wise, about 3.6M companies, with CIN, class, status, capital) is on this platform. That would be the free company-register denominator. MCA's own site (mca.gov.in) returned 403 Access Denied. API key needs free registration and the free tier is reportedly 1,000 requests a day. NCS vacancy datasets are catalogued at /catalog/national-career-service-ncs (403 to WebFetch).

sources.source: ABDM Health Facility Registry (HFR) – facility search
sources.count_method: Not verified. facility.abdm.gov.in/searchV2 and dashboard.abdm.gov.in returned CloudFront 403 'Request blocked' from this network. Per search snippets, the public search filters by name, location, speciality and facility type, and the ABDM dashboard shows state-wise facility counts.
sources.robots_or_terms: No evidence. robots.txt also returned 403.
sources.notes: The national hospital and clinic register (100k+ facilities per a PIB release). It is a denominator for hospital-system studies, not a source of software mentions. Re-test from an Indian IP.

sources.source: NSE – Corporate Announcements (JSON endpoint behind the website)
sources.count_method: GET https://www.nseindia.com/api/corporate-announcements?index=equities&from_date=DD-MM-YYYY&to_date=DD-MM-YYYY, after getting a cookie from the homepage. It returns a JSON array, so the total is the array length (18,239 announcements for 01-09-2026 to 05-10-2026). It has no keyword parameter. Filter client-side on 'attchmntText'/'desc' (1 hit for 'cobol' or 'core banking' in that window), or download the attachment PDFs and search their full text.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://www.nseindia.com/robots.txt, opened): User-agent * Allow: /, Disallow: /market-data-test. But the terms of use (opened) say: 'User is prohibited to conduct any systematic or automated data collection activities (including scraping, data mining...)'. Automated use needs NSE's written consent.
sources.notes: The endpoint is undocumented and internal. The terms forbid automated collection, so use it only by hand or with permission. Useful for listed banks, insurers and IT vendors disclosing core-banking, ERP or mainframe contracts. BSE's equivalent (api.bseindia.com) returned 403, and BSE has no robots.txt (it serves HTML).

sources.source: SEBI – Filings (e.g. Public Issues / Red Herring Documents, DRHPs)
sources.count_method: The listing UI prints 'X to Y of N records' (e.g. '1 to 25 of 1283 records' for RHPs filed with ROC). Keyword search posts to /sebiweb/ajax/home/getnewslistinfo.jsp with search=<term> and a session cookie. It matches titles and entity names only, not document text: 'core banking' returned 'No record(s) available'. The count is in the same 'of N records' string.
sources.robots_or_terms: https://www.sebi.gov.in/robots.txt (opened): User-agent * with empty Disallow, plus Disallow: /js, /hindi/js, /css. Filings pages are allowed. Terms page not checked.
sources.notes: Offer documents (DRHP/RHP) contain IT-system risk factors such as legacy core banking, but a keyword count needs the PDFs downloaded and searched in full text. The title search only gives counts of documents per entity or category.

sources.source: INAPROC API Gateway (LKPP), successor to ISB LKPP: Tender, Non-Tender, RUP (SiRUP plans) and e-Katalog datasets
sources.count_method: No total-count field confirmed. A third-party client (github.com/Aldbow/Data-Retrieval-INAPROC-LKPP) reports cursor pagination via meta.cursor and meta.has_more only, so a keyword count means paging the full result set and counting rows locally. Direct export is capped at 200 pages. No server-side keyword filter was verified.
sources.robots_or_terms: Not verified. data.inaproc.id/docs and its robots.txt return HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge (cf-mitigated: challenge) from this network. I did not try to get past it. A JWT bearer token is required (all routes fail without one, per the GitHub client). Whether outside researchers can get a token is not documented anywhere I could open.
sources.notes: Primary government source for tender and planning (RUP) data across ministries and local governments. The legacy ISB endpoints were due to be retired on 31 Jan 2026 (search snippet from the migration guide, which I could not open). sirup.lkpp.go.id does not resolve in DNS from here, and sirup.inaproc.id returns 403. Expect to need an Indonesian network and a token.

sources.source: SPSE on spse.inaproc.id (the LPSE e-tender portals, consolidated under INAPROC)
sources.count_method: Not verified. The open-source PyProc client (github.com/wakataw/pyproc) searches tender and non-tender packages by keyword across SPSE instances, with a 1-second default delay between requests. It does not document a count field, and I could not open the SPSE list pages to confirm one.
sources.robots_or_terms: spse.inaproc.id/robots.txt and spse.inaproc.id/kemenkeu/lelang both return HTTP 403 from this network. A third-party repo (github.com/suryast/indonesia-gov-apis) reports the site is geo-restricted behind Cloudflare Turnstile and that regional lpse.*.go.id portals broke after the migration. I did not try to get around this. PyProc's README asks users not to overload SPSE servers and says they are responsible for misuse.
sources.notes: Tender titles are where terms like 'core banking', 'SIMRS', 'SAP', 'mainframe' or 'AS400' would appear. Access probably needs an Indonesian IP, and keyword counting probably needs PyProc or similar.

sources.source: Opentender.net (Indonesia Corruption Watch), a reprocessed copy of LKPP tender data
sources.count_method: Not found. The /search page I opened shows a search box but no result count. /search?keyword=aplikasi rendered no results or count in the fetched HTML, so results probably load client-side. No public API was found, and the open-data link sits behind /login.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (served at dev.opentender.net/robots.txt after a 301 from opentender.net) is 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /', so all crawling is disallowed. The /license page puts the data under ODbL (attribution and share-alike).
sources.notes: Secondary source (NGO), built from LKPP data. Its licence allows reuse, but its robots.txt blocks automated access, so ask ICW (icw@antikorupsi.org) for a bulk extract.

sources.source: Kalibrr job board (kjs job_board search JSON)
sources.count_method: GET https://www.kalibrr.com/kjs/job_board/search?limit=1&offset=0&text=<keyword> and read the top-level 'count' field. Tested: 'core banking' = 96 with no country, 95 with &country=Indonesia, 90 with &country=Philippines. AS400 with &country=Indonesia = 2. Because Indonesia and Philippines give similar totals, the country parameter may not filter reliably. Check per-job google_location.address_components.country.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt disallows only /root and /candidate/profile, so the search path is not disallowed. However, the Terms (kalibrr.com/terms) say Kalibrr monitors and can prevent 'automated extraction, scraping'. Use is in a grey zone; keep volume low or ask permission.
sources.notes: The only job source here that returned a machine-readable total count. The endpoint is undocumented and used by the site's own front end.

sources.source: Karirhub Kemnaker (Ministry of Manpower national job portal)
sources.count_method: Not found. The homepage shows counts per job-function category (for example '19215 Lowongan' for Sales and Marketing) and remaining vacancies per posting, but no total for a keyword search. No public API was found.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt contains only the Cloudflare content-signals preamble (comments) and no Disallow rules or signal values. Under that preamble, the operator neither grants nor restricts permission. No terms of use were found.
sources.notes: Official government source. News reports cite 81,171 active vacancies across 32,086 companies as of Sept 2026. Category counts are visible, but keyword counts would need the site's internal API, which I did not find.

sources.source: Glints Indonesia job board
sources.count_method: Not verified. glints.com/id/opportunities/jobs/explore?keyword=cobol&country=ID returned HTTP 403 to a script.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt explicitly disallows '*/opportunities/jobs/explore?*', which is the keyword-search URL. Sitemaps are allowed (sitemap_index.xml, explore-page-id-sitemap.xml).
sources.notes: Keyword search is off-limits under robots.txt. The only compliant option is to read job pages listed in the sitemaps and count locally, which gives an approximate figure.

sources.source: JobStreet Indonesia (SEEK)
sources.count_method: Not verified. id.jobstreet.com/id/COBOL-jobs returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch, so I could not read the total-jobs text.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt disallows '*?' (any query string), '/api/jobsearch/', '/graphql' and '*/job/' for general user agents, and adds restrictions for AI crawlers. Clean SEO paths like /id/<keyword>-jobs are not disallowed but are bot-blocked in practice.
sources.notes: Largest commercial board in Indonesia, but no compliant automated count is available. Manual browser lookups of the total shown on /id/<keyword>-jobs pages are the realistic option.

sources.source: OJK list of head-office addresses for commercial and sharia banks (Daftar Alamat Kantor Pusat Bank Umum dan Syariah)
sources.count_method: Download the .xlsx (latest is June 2026) and count rows. This gives the denominator (all licensed commercial banks), not keyword counts.
sources.robots_or_terms: www.ojk.go.id/robots.txt returned 'Request Rejected' (WAF) to curl, so robots.txt could not be read. No explicit reuse terms were seen on the page. A third-party repo reports OJK is geo-blocked from some non-Indonesian locations.
sources.notes: Primary regulator source for the list of banks. The annual Direktori Perbankan Indonesia (PDF profiles plus XLS financials) adds ownership, employee counts and office networks for sizing.

sources.source: OJK Direktori Asuransi (quarterly directory of licensed insurers)
sources.count_method: Open the latest quarterly entry (Triwulan III 2025 was the newest listed) and count companies by type: life, general, reinsurance, sharia. I could not confirm the file format from the listing page.
sources.robots_or_terms: Same as ojk.go.id: robots.txt was unreadable (WAF rejection), and no explicit terms were found.
sources.notes: Primary regulator register of insurers. OJK also runs data.ojk.go.id/SJKPublic, a data catalog covering banking, capital markets and PPDP. I opened it but found no confirmed API or entity export.

sources.source: Kemenkes SIRS / RS Online hospital register
sources.count_method: GET https://sirs.kemkes.go.id/fo/home/list_prop_noncovid?id=0 returns JSON {provinsi:[{propinsi_name,kode,jumlah}], rs:...}. Summing 'jumlah' over the 39 provinces gave 3,690 active hospitals. A per-hospital list is served by https://sirs.kemkes.go.id/fo//home/listrs (an AJAX endpoint I saw in the page source but did not test). Profiles are at /fo/home/profile_rs/<code>.
sources.robots_or_terms: sirs.kemkes.go.id/robots.txt returns 404 (there is no robots.txt). No terms of use were seen on the dashboard.
sources.notes: Primary Ministry of Health register and the denominator for hospital-system (SIMRS) studies. The JSON endpoints are undocumented internal AJAX endpoints. SATUSEHAT (the FHIR API) requires registration.

sources.source: AHU Online (Ministry of Law company register: PT, CV, foundations)
sources.count_method: None. The free name check shows only similar names, not a match count (per panduan.ahu.go.id). Full company profiles are paid (Rp500,000 full, Rp50,000 latest, per a secondary guide). There is no bulk download or API for the public.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Allow: /'. A third-party repo reports CAPTCHA on the search forms and IP restrictions. CAPTCHA would rule out automated use.
sources.notes: Authoritative company register, but not usable for counts. Use it only to verify individual entities by hand.

sources.source: IDX (Indonesia Stock Exchange): listed-company financial and annual reports
sources.count_method: Not verified. The annual-report page returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) to both WebFetch and curl. Annual reports would have to be downloaded one by one and text-searched for terms like 'core banking', 'T24', 'SAP', 'AS/400' to count companies.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt itself is behind a Cloudflare 'Attention Required' block, so it could not be read. A third-party repo reports Cloudflare bot protection from both Australian and Indonesian IPs. Automated access is effectively blocked. I did not try to get past it.
sources.notes: Primary source for disclosures of listed banks and insurers, which often name core-system vendors in their IT sections. Manual download only. There is no verified API or bulk channel.

sources.source: Portal Satu Data Indonesia (data.go.id, Bappenas)
sources.count_method: https://data.go.id/dataset?q=<keyword> shows 'N Datasets Found' (for example 'rumah sakit' = 5.367, i.e. 5,367). This counts datasets, not organisations. The CKAN path /api/3/action/package_search returned a Next.js HTML page rather than JSON, so the CKAN API is not available at that path.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt allows all paths except /private/ and lists sitemap.xml. No dataset licence terms were visible on the homepage.
sources.notes: Meta-portal (707,036+ datasets) for finding regional lists of hospitals, local government agencies (OPD) and IT asset inventories. It does not count legacy software directly.

sources.source: Vietnam National e-Procurement System (muasamcong / VNEPS, Ministry of Finance)
sources.count_method: No documented public count. The contractor-selection search page (keyword field with 'match all words' / 'exact phrase' options) did not show a total result count when fetched. The service displayed 'egp-portal-contractor-selection-v2 is temporarily unavailable' at the time. The portal's statistics pages bind a totalElements field in their templates, so the backing JSON search probably returns a total. I could not confirm that endpoint: DNS failed from my sandbox and I found no public API docs. Plan for a headless browser that reads the paginated total.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://muasamcong.mpi.gov.vn/robots.txt, opened): 'User-Agent: * / Disallow:' (empty), so all paths are allowed. No terms of use found on the pages I opened.
sources.notes: Primary source for public tenders on core banking, ERP, HIS (hospital IS) and e-government. The old system stopped on 15 Jan 2024 and has an archive search at /egp/archivefe/dashboard. Statistics page: https://muasamcong.mpi.gov.vn/en/web/guest/statistical (aggregate metrics, no export or API seen). Commercial aggregators (DauThau.info) rent copies of this data, which suggests there is no free bulk download.

sources.source: ITviec (IT job board)
sources.count_method: Open https://itviec.com/it-jobs/<keyword-slug> and parse the H1 '<N> <keyword> jobs in Vietnam'. Verified 2026-10-05: '16 core banking jobs in Vietnam' (/it-jobs/core-banking) and '1 cobol job in Vietnam' (/it-jobs/cobol). No public API found.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://itviec.com/robots.txt, opened): 'User-Agent: * Allow: /' with only '/subscriptions/new' disallowed. Terms: /terms-conditions returned 404, so I found no scraping clause.
sources.notes: IT-only board, best signal for COBOL, AS400, T24 and Flexcube skill demand. Also checked /it-jobs/cobol.

sources.source: CareerViet (CareerBuilder Vietnam)
sources.count_method: Open https://www.careerviet.vn/viec-lam/<keyword>-k-vi.html and parse the title 'Tuyển dụng <N> việc làm <keyword> MỚI <date>'. Verified: 'Tuyển dụng 44 việc làm core banking MỚI 05/10/2026'.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://www.careerviet.vn/robots.txt, opened) explicitly allows Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot and others. It blocks CCBot, Amazonbot, Bytespider, Diffbot, ia_archiver and YouBot. For all agents it disallows /api/*, /vi/jobs/*, /en/jobs/* and /counter/*. The /viec-lam/ keyword pages are not disallowed. Terms of use not checked.
sources.notes: General board with a large banking and finance share. Use a generic user agent and follow the per-bot rules.

sources.source: VietnamWorks
sources.count_method: Open https://www.vietnamworks.com/viec-lam?q=<keyword> and parse '<N> việc làm phù hợp'. Verified: q=core-banking gives '7 việc làm phù hợp'; q=as400 gives '0 việc làm phù hợp'. The page renders client-side, and I found no documented public API.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://www.vietnamworks.com/robots.txt, opened) disallows profile, career-center, login, apply, preview, AJAX and ad-tracking paths. The /viec-lam search path is not listed. Terms (https://www.vietnamworks.com/thoa-thuan-su-dung, opened) ban mass or automated account registration and use for non-recruitment purposes. I found no explicit anti-scraping clause.
sources.notes: Large general board. Low counts for niche legacy keywords.

sources.source: TopCV
sources.count_method: No evidence. The search page https://www.topcv.vn/tim-viec-lam-core-banking returned HTTP 403 to my fetcher, so I could not confirm a count string. It probably needs a real browser.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened): User-agent * disallows only CV and private paths (/cv/*, /private/, /xem-cv/, /viet-cv/, /p/, etc.). Job search paths are not disallowed. The live 403 shows bot protection, though. Terms not checked.
sources.notes: The largest Vietnamese job board by traffic, but automated access is blocked in practice.

sources.source: State Bank of Vietnam: register of joint-stock commercial banks (plus lists of state-owned banks, foreign bank branches and finance companies)
sources.count_method: Count the rows of the HTML table. As of 30/06/2026 it lists 34 joint-stock commercial banks, with name, address, licence number and date, and charter capital. The other categories have their own SBV pages (state-owned commercial banks, finance companies list as of 30/6/2025). No keyword query. This is the denominator for banks.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://www.sbv.gov.vn/robots.txt, opened): 'User-Agent: * Disallow:' (all allowed), with a sitemap. Terms not checked. One SBV list page (foreign bank branches) returned 403 to my fetcher.
sources.notes: HTML only. No XLS, PDF or API seen. Past versions are linked as separate documents.

sources.source: National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
sources.count_method: No evidence of a keyword count. The homepage offers 'Tìm doanh nghiệp' (lookup by enterprise code or name) but shows no result count, bulk download or public API. Data exchange APIs exist only for connecting government systems (an MPI technical document found via search). Per-enterprise lookups only.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt returned 404 (none published). The footer links to 'ĐIỀU KHOẢN SỬ DỤNG' (terms of use), but I did not read the terms text.
sources.notes: Authoritative company register, including VSIC industry codes. Useful for resolving names to IDs, not for counts.

sources.source: Ministry of Health, Medical Examination and Treatment Administration (kcb.vn): lists of licensed health facilities
sources.count_method: No keyword query. Download the attached lists and count the rows: a PDF as of 31/12/2020 (Official Letter 5126/BYT-KCB) and a Word file via OneDrive dated January 2025. The page gives no total. This is the denominator for hospitals.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (https://kcb.vn/robots.txt, opened) disallows /data/, /lib/, /packages/, /portals/, /pages/, /1/ and /content/download/. Article pages are allowed, but attachments under /content/download/ are disallowed. Terms not checked.
sources.notes: This list covers only facilities qualified for health examinations, not all hospitals. Facilities with health-insurance contracts are searchable at the VSS portal (next source).

sources.source: Vietnam Social Security (BHXH) lookups: participating employers and health facilities with insurance contracts
sources.count_method: No count is available programmatically. Every lookup form needs an image CAPTCHA, and the page states no result counts.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt not checked. The CAPTCHA blocks automated querying, and bypassing it is not acceptable.
sources.notes: Listed for completeness. Manual use only.

sources.source: Ministry of Finance, Insurance Supervisory Authority: list of insurers and foreign branches
sources.count_method: No evidence. The register entry page (example: Bao Long Insurance) returned only a title to my fetcher, likely a client-side render, so I could not see the list or a count. Search snippets give about 33 non-life and 18 life insurers, but those are secondary figures.
sources.robots_or_terms: Unknown. The robots.txt fetch returned the portal HTML title instead of a robots file.
sources.notes: This is the primary register of insurers (the denominator for insurance). It needs a browser to render.

sources.source: SSC disclosure system (congbothongtin.ssc.gov.vn): listed and public company reports
sources.count_method: The page shows 'Tổng số tin: <N>' (total items) with pagination, 16,910 at fetch time, filterable by exchange, ticker and report type. I saw no free-text keyword search over report contents, so legacy-vendor mentions require downloading each report and searching it.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt returned 404 (none). Terms not found.
sources.notes: Per-row download icons for financial and annual reports. No API seen. Annual reports of banks and insurers sometimes name core systems (for example T24 or Flexcube upgrades).

sources.source: Ho Chi Minh City Stock Exchange (HOSE) disclosure news
sources.count_method: No evidence. The disclosure page returned only a header to my fetcher (client-rendered), so I could not confirm keyword search or counts.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened): 'User-agent: * Disallow:' (all allowed). HNX robots.txt could not be fetched (TLS certificate error). Terms not checked.
sources.notes: Overlaps with the SSC system. Data portal data.gov.vn (CKAN) was unreachable from my environment (DNS failure), so its API is unverified.

sources.source: MyPROCUREMENT (Ministry of Finance): tender adverts, tender results, and archive of results
sources.count_method: Undocumented JSON endpoint behind the public search pages: GET https://myprocurement.treasury.gov.my/procurements/fetch?type=<results|advertisements|archive>&category=<tender|results-tender|...>&itemsPerPage=10&procurement_title=<keyword> with header Accept: application/json. Read the response field 'total' (also 'lastPage'; 'truncated'=true when unfiltered). Tested 2026-10-05: archive results-tender total=24297 unfiltered, 'sistem'=905, 'ICT'=615; live adverts 'sistem'=71; live results 'sistem maklumat'=3, 'mainframe'=0, 'perbankan'=0. Other filters: procurement_category, procurement_ministry, procurement_agency, procurement_winner (winning bidder name), date ranges. The page also has PDF/EXCEL export of selected results.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened) is 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' so all paths are allowed. I did not find or open a terms-of-use page. The fetch endpoint is not a published API and could change.
sources.notes: Best MY procurement source for counts. Malay keywords work better than English, e.g. sistem, perisian, aplikasi, pangkalan data, SAP, Oracle. Winner names allow counting vendors (integrators) per agency. Tender archive URL: https://myprocurement.treasury.gov.my/arkib/keputusan-tender/ ; adverts: https://myprocurement.treasury.gov.my/iklan/tender/. Covers ePerolehan/MyGPIS federal procurement only, not state or GLC tenders.

sources.source: Bank Negara Malaysia Financial Sector Participants (FSP) Directory
sources.count_method: The HTML page shows 'Showing 1 - 200 of 237 results' (all participant types). Paginate with the Liferay params ..._delta=200&..._cur=2. To count by type, tally the license-type label per row. Page 1 tally gave Licensed Commercial Bank 24, Licensed Islamic Bank 16, Licensed Investment Bank 10, Licensed Digital Bank 3. There is no keyword search over software; it is the denominator register for banks, insurers, takaful operators and DFIs.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened at https://www.bnm.gov.my/robots.txt): User-agent * disallows only /view.php?*. Named crawlers (AhrefsBot, SemrushBot, ccbot, etc.) are fully disallowed. I did not open BNM website terms. BNM OpenAPI (https://apikijangportal.bnm.gov.my/) exists, but I found no institution-list endpoint there.
sources.notes: Category list pages (e.g. https://www.bnm.gov.my/commercial-banks) and hub https://www.bnm.gov.my/list-of-licensed-financial-institutions. I found no bulk download file. Insurer and takaful counts were not tallied (likely on page 2).

sources.source: KKM (Ministry of Health) registered private health facilities: ArcGIS MapServer behind MyGeoCKAPS
sources.count_method: ArcGIS REST query with returnCountOnly. Private hospitals are layer 1: https://mygos.mygeoportal.gov.my/gisserver/rest/services/KKM/FASILITI_KESIHATAN_SWASTA_PUBLIC/MapServer/1/query?where=1%3D1&returnCountOnly=true&f=json returned {"count":214}. Keyword: where=NAMA_PENUH_FASILITI LIKE '%KPJ%' returned 18. Other layers: 0 hemodialysis, 5 medical clinics, 4 dental, 6 ambulatory, etc. maxRecordCount=2000, so full download is possible via paged query.
sources.robots_or_terms: https://mygos.mygeoportal.gov.my/robots.txt returned a 404 page, so no robots file. I found no terms for the service. It is a public, unauthenticated ArcGIS service linked from the official portal https://www.malaysia.gov.my/en/categories/health/health-facilities-and-amenities/private-health-facilities.
sources.notes: Private facilities only, with no software fields. Use it as the denominator of private hospitals (with bed counts JUMLAH_KATIL). Public MOH hospitals are not in this service. data.gov.my has only aggregate public-hospital bed counts.

sources.source: Labuan FSA Financial Institutions Directory
sources.count_method: The page has a dropdown filter by list (Labuan Banks and Investment Banks, Labuan Insurance & Insurance-Related Entities, Leasing, Fund Managers, etc.) and a name search. No total count is displayed, so count the rendered entries per list. The 'Download this file' button has href='#' (client-side), and I could not resolve a direct file URL.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened) is 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' so everything is allowed. I did not open the terms.
sources.notes: Offshore (Labuan IBFC) banks and insurers. Use it as a denominator alongside BNM. Last updated label: 10 Oct 2025.

sources.source: SSM e-Info (Companies Commission of Malaysia company register)
sources.count_method: none for free. Search requires login ('Please sign in to see full results'). Company Listing costs RM23.24 plus RM4.08 per entry. Bulk (Corporate Subscription Data) and API (Corporate Integration Data) are by sales enquiry. I found no free count method.
sources.robots_or_terms: I did not read the Terms of Service text (only the link is on the page). Not free.
sources.notes: Included to record that the official company register is paid. SSM product page https://www.ssm.com.my/Pages/Product/Business-Information.aspx lists per-document fees (about RM10) and no free tier.

sources.source: JobStreet Malaysia (SEEK)
sources.count_method: The search page (e.g. /cobol-jobs) shows a job total in the UI, but automated fetches returned HTTP 403 (curl and WebFetch), so I could not verify a count. Manual browser check only.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened): disallows */job/, *?, /graphql and /api/jobsearch/, but allows *?keywords. A specific block for anthropic-ai, GPTBot and CCBot disallows /companies and */job/. Terms clause 7(d) forbids 'data mining, robots, screen scraping' without prior written consent. Clause 9(b) bans bots and scrapers used to query or search.
sources.notes: Largest MY job board, but terms prohibit automated counting. Use manual spot counts or seek written consent.

sources.source: Indeed Malaysia
sources.count_method: No verified method. https://malaysia.indeed.com/jobs?q=cobol returned HTTP 403 to both curl and WebFetch.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened): User-agent * Allow: / with paging allowed up to start=90, disallowing /api/*, /ads/, /advanced_search and others. I did not open the terms of service.
sources.notes: Bot protection blocks automated access in practice.

sources.source: Hiredly (Malaysia)
sources.count_method: none verified. https://my.hiredly.com/jobs?search=cobol returns 200, but the server-rendered __NEXT_DATA__ holds only the first 30 jobs and no total field. The bundle references an internal GraphQL host (readonly.hiredly.com/api/v2/graphql). It is undocumented and I did not probe it.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt (opened) only lists Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot and ChatGPT-User with Allow: /. There is no generic User-agent * rule. The terms page https://my.hiredly.com/terms-and-conditions rendered without the terms text, so the terms are unknown.
sources.notes: Tech-skewed MY board. Counts would require manual page reading.

sources.source: MYFutureJobs (PERKESO / SOCSO national job portal)
sources.count_method: No evidence. Connection refused (ECONNREFUSED 112.137.168.104:443) from both curl and WebFetch, likely geo-restricted outside Malaysia.
sources.robots_or_terms: Could not retrieve robots.txt (connection refused).
sources.notes: Government job portal and potentially the best public-sector and GLC vacancy source. Re-test from a Malaysian IP.

sources.source: Bursa Malaysia company announcements (annual reports, material contracts)
sources.count_method: No evidence. Both the announcement search URL and robots.txt returned a Cloudflare managed challenge (HTTP 403 'Just a moment...'). I did not bypass it.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt is unreadable behind the Cloudflare challenge. Terms not opened.
sources.notes: Listed banks, insurers and hospital groups disclose core-system contracts here. Access needs a manual browser, a licensed data feed, or permission.

sources.source: Laporan Ketua Audit Negara (Auditor-General reports portal)
sources.count_method: No evidence. lkan.audit.gov.my and its robots.txt both returned a WAF 'Request Rejected' page.
sources.robots_or_terms: Unreadable (WAF rejected the request for robots.txt).
sources.notes: The reports audit ministry ICT projects and legacy systems. A dashboard is reportedly at agdashboard.audit.gov.my (not opened). Re-test from MY or a browser.

sources.source: data.gov.my Data Catalogue API (official open data)
sources.count_method: The API has no count or meta-total parameter in the docs. Filters: filter, ifilter, contains, icontains, range, limit, include, exclude, sort, and date ranges. To count, request with icontains=<kw>@<column> and a high limit, then count the rows returned.
sources.robots_or_terms: Rate limit is 4 requests per minute across all APIs, and HTTP 429 when exceeded (https://developer.data.gov.my/rate-limit). No token mentioned. I did not open the licence terms.
sources.notes: Low direct relevance. I found no company, bank or procurement registers in the catalogue, only aggregate health stats (e.g. hospital beds by state). Useful only for denominators.

sources.source: Thai Government Spending / e-GP contracts API (opend.data.go.th govspending, CGDContract / egp-contract)
sources.count_method: Not verified. Endpoint https://opend.data.go.th/govspending/service/egp-contract?keyword=<term>&year=<BE year> returned HTTP 401 {"message":"No API key found in request"} without a key (free key from opend.data.go.th/register_api). Third-party wrappers describe 100 records per page with offset/limit and do not document a total-count field. To get a total: page through to the end and count, unless a count field appears in the real response. The official documentation page (govspending.data.go.th/api/documentation) returned 403 Access Denied from this IP.
sources.robots_or_terms: opend.data.go.th/robots.txt redirected (302) and could not be read. data.go.th and govspending.data.go.th returned a WAF 'Access Denied' page (403) to this non-Thai IP, so their terms were not read. Use is gated by an API key and an HTTP 429 rate limit (seen in the TORBIDD client code at github.com/MTPeraya/TORBIDD/pull/114).
sources.notes: This is the primary structured feed of e-GP contracts. Project names can be searched with keywords such as ระบบ core banking, ERP, HIS (hospital information system), or COBOL/AS400 maintenance contracts. Third-party docs claim coverage from FY2558 (2015) onward and a winnerTin field, which lets you count contracts per vendor. Thai geo/WAF blocking is likely, so plan for a Thai-hosted runner.

sources.source: National e-GP portal (gprocurement.go.th / process5 announcement search)
sources.count_method: none. The process5 search page returned 'Request Rejected' (F5 WAF) to curl, so no count was observed. Use the govspending API above for counts.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt says 'User-agent: * Disallow: /'. All automated crawling is disallowed.
sources.notes: Only usable by hand for spot checks (TOR documents). Do not scrape. The structured equivalent is the opend.data.go.th govspending API.

sources.source: GD Catalog (Government Data Catalog, CKAN), gdcatalog.go.th
sources.count_method: GET https://gdcatalog.go.th/api/3/action/package_search?q=<keyword>&rows=0 and read result.count. Tested: q=จัดซื้อจัดจ้าง gave count 111, q=hospital gave 36, q=สถาบันการเงิน gave 57. This counts datasets, not organisations.
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt has 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' (Googlebot has a separate group that disallows /api/ with Crawl-Delay 10). So generic automated access is disallowed by robots, even though the CKAN API answers without a key. Individual datasets carry licences such as 'Open Data Common'.
sources.notes: Use it as a discovery index to find agency datasets (for example the MOPH Hcode dataset and SFI loan/NPL datasets), not as a direct count of legacy-system users. Because of the robots restriction, make only light, manual-rate calls or ask the publisher.

sources.source: MOPH health service unit register (Hcode), Office of the Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Public Health
sources.count_method: The GD Catalog entry describes a real-time dashboard of counts by organisation type at https://hcode.moph.go.th/dashboard/health_office_type/. Both that dashboard and /dashboard/filter/health_offices/ returned HTTP 403 from this IP, so the count method was not verified.
sources.robots_or_terms: Licence on the catalog entry is 'Open Data Common', with no access restrictions stated. hcode.moph.go.th/robots.txt returns 404 (no robots file). Pages returned 403 to a non-Thai IP.
sources.notes: This is the denominator for hospitals: the 5-digit and new 9-digit codes, plus type and sector (public/private). Contact for the data is data.hcode@gmail.com. Geo-blocking is likely, so test from a Thai IP.

sources.source: DBD DataWarehouse+ (Department of Business Development juristic-person register)
sources.count_method: Not verified. The site is a Nuxt single-page app with an internal /v1/ API (company-profiles search, biztype/TSIC, stats) that uses anonymous tokens behind a WAF challenge, per the third-party MCP wrapper github.com/sanookjung/datawarehouse-dbd-mcp. No documented public count field. The bulk registration CSVs on opendata.dbd.go.th (CKAN) returned an Incapsula 403.
sources.robots_or_terms: datawarehouse.dbd.go.th/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' (empty, so everything is allowed). The site still shows a login modal and cookie banner, and its WAF challenge means automated use needs a challenge bypass. Do not bypass it. Terms were not read. opendata.dbd.go.th returned 403 (Incapsula).
sources.notes: This is the company denominator, with TSIC codes for filtering, for example to banks (64xx), insurers (65xx) and hospitals (8610). Counts by TSIC code are likely in the /v1/stats or biztype endpoints, but that is unconfirmed.

sources.source: Bank of Thailand list of financial service providers (fi-list) and BOT API portal
sources.count_method: The fi-list page loads (HTTP 200) but the list renders in JavaScript, and WebFetch saw no counts or export link. Count by hand per category (commercial banks, SFIs, and so on). The BOT API catalogue (portal.api.bot.or.th) offers 'BOT License Check', interest rates, statistics and FI holidays. It needs a token, and no institution-directory count endpoint was seen.
sources.robots_or_terms: bot.or.th/robots.txt disallows only /_layouts/, /_vti_bin/ and /_catalogs/, so everything else is allowed. The API portal requires registration and has a 'Terms of use' link that was not read.
sources.notes: This is the denominator of banks and SFIs, the core-banking population, at roughly a few dozen institutions. It is small enough to enumerate by hand. The BOT 'List of Commercial Bank Branches' is at /th/fi-branch.html.

sources.source: Office of Insurance Commission (OIC): insurer standard-code reference and e-service company lists
sources.count_method: The OIC reference PDF '20200625_รหัสมาตรฐาน_บริษัทประกันภัย.pdf' (1.45 MB, served via onlinewebadt.oic.or.th SRD00100 Download?keySource=337) lists insurer codes and names. Count its rows. oiceservice.oic.or.th links life (ประกันชีวิต) and non-life (ประกันวินาศภัย) company lists but shows no counts or export. www.oic.or.th is a Nuxt app with a reCAPTCHA config, so its HTML has no list content.
sources.robots_or_terms: www.oic.or.th/robots.txt is 'Allow: /' with Disallow /web-admin/ and /api/. oiceservice.oic.or.th/robots.txt returns 404 (no file). The licence-search page says the data is general public information only. No API.
sources.notes: This is the denominator of insurers (around 70+ life and non-life). The 2020 PDF may be stale, so cross-check it against the oiceservice lists. Only the HTTP headers were checked, not the file contents.

sources.source: SEC Thailand Open Data API: One Report (Form 56-1) and License-Check
sources.count_method: No full-text keyword search or total-count endpoint. One-Report endpoints are per company and year, for example /v1/one-report/sbo/{year}/info/{lang}, /sbo/{year}/risk/{unique_id} and /sbo/{year}/rd/{unique_id}. List endpoints use page_size (1 to 100) and next_cursor. To count, enumerate companies via /sbo/{year}/info, pull the risk and business sections, grep them locally for core banking, mainframe or ERP, and count matches.
sources.robots_or_terms: Requires a free subscription key (header Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key, base https://api.sec.or.th). The official portals secopendata.sec.or.th (403) and api-portal.sec.or.th (DNS failure) could not be opened, so the terms were not read. The endpoint list comes from an unofficial mirror dated 26 May 2026.
sources.notes: This is the best primary filing source for listed banks and insurers that disclose IT-system risk or replacement projects. The SEC licensee directory page market.sec.or.th COMPANYPROFILE03 showed 18 securities companies and 17 non-securities licensees, with no export.

sources.source: Stock Exchange of Thailand: List of SET Listed Companies (Excel, weekly)
sources.count_method: Download listedCompanies_en_US.xls (it redirects 301 to weblink.set.or.th/dat/eod/listedcompany/static/) and count rows, filtering on the industry/sector column (Banking, Insurance, ICT). No keyword search API.
sources.robots_or_terms: set.or.th/robots.txt disallows /dat/, /data/, /set/, /config/ and others. The Excel file sits under /dat/, so automated fetching is disallowed by robots. Download it by hand. Terms were not read.
sources.notes: This is the denominator of listed companies by sector, for joining with SEC One Report data.

sources.source: JobThai
sources.count_method: Open https://www.jobthai.com/th/jobs?keyword=<term> and read the header 'พบ N ตำแหน่งงาน'. Observed: COBOL gave 11 and AS400 gave 12 (5 Oct 2026).
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt has 'User-agent: * Allow: /' with crawl-delays for named bots (Googlebot 10s, bingbot 60s). The disallows (/resume/, /home/, /corporate/ and others) sit after a block of named bots including JobBot. Job search pages are allowed. The terms of service were not read. No public API.
sources.notes: Thai-language market. Search Thai and English terms (COBOL, AS400, RPG, mainframe, SAP, T24, Core Banking). Employer names on the listings let you count organisations.

sources.source: Jobsdb Thailand (SEEK)
sources.count_method: Open https://th.jobsdb.com/<Keyword>-jobs and read the 'N jobs' header. Observed: COBOL gave 26 jobs (5 Oct 2026).
sources.robots_or_terms: robots.txt for *: Disallow */job/, any URL with '?' except *?keywords and *?advertiserid, /graphql and /api/jobsearch/. That allows /<kw>-jobs and ?keywords search pages but not job detail pages or the API. The anthropic-ai, GPTBot and CCBot agents are additionally barred from /companies. The terms page (/terms-and-conditions) returned 404, so the terms were not read.
sources.notes: Use only the search-result count pages, at a low rate. Job detail pages are disallowed, so getting employer names needs manual review or another route.

sources.source: PhilGEPS (Procurement Service-DBM) open tenders bulletin: 'View More Open Tenders' search
sources.count_method: POST to https://philgeps.gov.ph/Indexes/viewMoreOpenTenders with form field searchKeyword=<term> plus the page's _csrfToken and session cookie (GET the page first). The result page prints 'showing 20 record(s) out of N total'; parse N. Tested 2026-10-05: software=57, ERP=31, hospital=86, 'core banking'=0; unfiltered=7,097. Covers OPEN tenders only (a point-in-time snapshot, not history). Other filters: searchAreaDel, searchPublishDateFrom/To, searchBudgetFrom/To. Pagination: /indexes/view-more-open-tenders?page=N.
sources.robots_or_terms: https://philgeps.gov.ph/robots.txt has no robots file. It returns the HTML homepage, which carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">. notices.philgeps.gov.ph/robots.txt returns 404. No API or terms covering automated access were found. The open.philgeps.gov.ph Terms link (termsAndConditionsBuyer.php) returned 404.
sources.notes: Best free procurement source for counts. No official API. The keyword probably matches notice titles only (ERP=31 suggests substring matches). Count manually before relying on it. A POST to the main /Indexes/index form with searchNoticeTitle returned an HTTP 500 error page, so use the viewMoreOpenTenders form. The legacy ASP.NET portal (notices.philgeps.gov.ph/GEPSNONPILOT/...) uses __doPostBack. Its category view shows per-category open counts (for example '153 categories found', Catering Services [562]) but no keyword total.

sources.source: PhilGEPS award notices (getAwardNotices) and former opportunities (getFormerOpportunities)
sources.count_method: No total is printed. The award search form has searchAwardNoticeNo, searchRefNo and searchLineItem (Award Title). My test POSTs with searchLineItem/searchKeyword returned rows but no 'out of N total' string. To get a count you would have to paginate and count rows yourself. Unverified beyond that.
sources.robots_or_terms: Same host as above: no robots.txt, homepage meta noindex,nofollow, no published terms on automated access found.
sources.notes: Historical (awarded) contracts are what show who bought a core banking, ERP or hospital system. This source can't give a total in one query.
